services.name: Dead Tree Removal Rebate Program
services.desc: Properties in the City's WUI are eligible to receive a rebate of up to $1,000 per residence to cover costs associated with the removal of a dead tree. The rebate program is being administered by the Santa Clara County FireSafe Council through an agreement with the City. Rebates will be allocated on a first-come,
